title: Bar Drop Blue Razz Lemonade 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Blue Razz Lemonade by Drop is a sparkling fruit beverage blend that refreshes the palate. The profile begins with the deep, tangy sweetness of blue raspberries, delivering a bold berry punch. This is immediately lifted by a zesty lemonade finish, adding a layer of citrus sparkle that makes every puff feel brisk and enlivening. This nic salt e-liquid features a specific 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, designed to maximise flavour transmission and wicking speed in low-powered devices. The result is a crystal-clear taste profile suitable for any MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kit. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, it offers a smooth draw and efficient nicotine delivery. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
